description: Free, no key: the tokens of the Elysium pools with the most trading volume over the last 24 hours, in the order GeckoTerminal lists them (the Top volume list of Trade on Trnch), with a link to trade each. A volume ranking, not a screen, a verdict or a recommendation: Trnch runs no rug screen on this chain.
